scope: Identical-message synthetic regression comparison. Reused engineering holdouts and curated challenge cases do not establish real-student or clinical accuracy.
challenge_scope: Developer-authored English regression messages, not clinical labels or an independent population evaluation. Keep separate from training and hyperparameter selection.

uncertainty.confidence_definition: Maximum raw class probability; not the probability of the final threshold-adjusted support decision.

confidence_intervals.limitations: Approximate sampling variability for a fixed model and thresholds. Does not cover training, annotation error, dataset shift or clinical validity. Null bounds mean insufficient groups, unsupported classes, or no observed variation; perfect observations do not prove zero future errors.

calibration.scope: Raw class probabilities and argmax predictions, before policy thresholds.
